# Colecto v0.11.6

Patch release upgrading HTML email rendering to lazy, sandboxed platform WebViews across desktop and mobile, preserving sanitized `<style>` stylesheets in Rust, and eliminating the delay when opening messages.

## Changes

- **Lazy, sandboxed platform WebView for HTML mail**:
  - **Linux**: Added a first-party ephemeral WebKitGTK 4.1 (`webkit2gtk-4.1`) WebView host with JavaScript, storage, and devtools disabled, external link interception to the OS browser, Wayland `WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1` guard, automatic hiding behind modals/routes, and full teardown on unmount so zero WebView RAM stays alive when no HTML message is open.
  - **Windows, macOS, Android & iOS**: Wired lazy, incognito, JavaScript-disabled native OS WebViews (`flutter_inappwebview`) with external link interception.
  - **Web**: Unified the `<iframe sandbox>` HTML document builder with desktop and mobile.
- **Sanitized `<style>` CSS preservation**: Rust's HTML sanitizer (`colecto-core`) now preserves safe `<style>` blocks (such as `.preheader { display: none; }` and `@media` responsive table rules) and `class`/`id` attributes while stripping remote fetches (`@import`, `@font-face`, `url(...)`, `image-set(...)`), `expression(...)`, `position: fixed/sticky`, and `html`/`body` hiding rules.
- **Instant message open & parallel FFI worker pool**: `MailController.selectThread` now starts loading message content, marking seen, and fetching summaries immediately instead of waiting on the conversation query, and `NativeFfiBridge` now uses a 4-worker isolate pool so background sync or flag updates no longer stall opening messages.
